notablePrerequisites:
"Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Draw a card, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token instead.
The Bear token enters the battlefield, triggering Dire Undercurrents' first ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Bear token, adding {1}.
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Resolve the Dire Undercurrents trigger from step 3, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
